report.summary: Review of TimePolicyPanel.tsx focused on React effect loops, persisted mutations, and display-mismatch defects. Only reproducible issues are reported; no API/domain changes are proposed.

findings.title: Locale effect updates sourceNote even when locale unchanged after editedNote reset
findings.evidence: useEffect depends on [language]. sourceNoteEdited.current is only set true on textarea onChange. After a locale change and subsequent manual edit, sourceNoteEdited.current remains true, yet the effect still updates sourceNote on every language change (including a change back to the same locale). No check compares current draft.sourceNote to defaultSourceNote(language).
findings.reproduction: 1. As buyer, edit sourceNote manually (sets sourceNoteEdited=true). 2. Switch language from en to zh (effect overwrites sourceNote). 3. Switch language back to en (effect overwrites sourceNote again, because edited flag still true). Manual edit is lost after the second switch, despite user having edited the note.
findings.suggestion: Track a previous language ref and only update when language actually changes; optionally compare draft.sourceNote to defaultSourceNote to decide. Reset sourceNoteEdited when intentionally overwriting only if user did not edit.

findings.title: Preview table labels may show stale old label when policy minutes change without running prepare
findings.evidence: caseLabel(item,draft) uses current draft policy minutes, but preview is only regenerated by prepare(). If user changes leadMinutes after preview without clicking preview, table labels update immediately but item.id/localStart/expected derive from stale timePolicyCases(plan()) result. Mismatch between displayed labels and actual test inputs.
findings.reproduction: 1. Set leadMinutes=120, click preview. 2. Change leadMinutes to 130 (input) without clicking preview. 3. Table row label 'lead_exact' displays '提前130分钟预约' but item was generated from 120-minute plan and localStart is from old plan.
findings.suggestion: Either disable label update until preview regenerated, or recompute preview on draft change, or store a snapshot of plan used for preview and use that plan in caseLabel.

findings.title: Session display uses stale session.plan.sourceNote but no current draft/language override; possible mismatch after locale switch
findings.evidence: Saved session.plan.sourceNote is rendered as literal text. If note was saved under one language, switch language doesn't translate it. Task says display-only followup should use current draft/session policy minutes and language for new format names, but saved sourceNote is explicitly not to be rewritten.
findings.reproduction: Save a session with sourceNote in English, switch UI to Chinese. Session note remains English, which is expected per requirements (never rewrite saved case.label/sourceNote/rawtrace), but may be perceived as mismatch.
findings.suggestion: No change required if requirement is to preserve saved sourceNote; document that saved notes are not localized.

limitations: No API/domain changes considered; review only of provided component.
Only reproducible defects from code review are reported; cannot execute runtime to confirm.
